# units/hour

> n hour: hours: 60 min, as nanoseconds.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/hour.pkg)

```
print 1 hour   // 3600000000000
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 hour` is `2 * (3 hour)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{n: expr int} hour -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
